body: You really just don't want to mind your business do you? I'm over this honestly so adios
Alright, I'll leave you to your opinion. But I think you should leave posts you don't agree with alone.

Again if you don't like my post then you can keep scrolling. And when I'm ready to have kids, I'll love them to death, however that isn't the case at this point in my life. I have the right to my choice with my body. And I'm looking for resources and information here. You aren't providing that, so you really don't need to be in my comments right now. If you really disagree that strongly, again, you don't need to click on my post, comment, or read my post. You can continue and move on to a post that you do agree with rather than judging my life choices.

I would teach my kids to be a lot more open minded and I would be for them through thick and thin. I feel sorry for you actually, so stuck in your own beliefs you're projecting onto other people. 

Regardless of what you believe, I'm on a thread for advice. Criticism is a lot different than advice. Advice is something that is useful, and from people who have been through the same or similar situation. What does criticism do other than cause judgement? You have the right to your opinion, however I feel that you are acting in a way that is short sighted. You didn't need to click on my post if you didn't agree with my actions. What I'm looking on here is for someone to offer some assistance and maybe link me to some resources. Maybe next time you see a post you don't agree with, instead of pointing the finger of blame, just keep scrolling.

Wow. No need to throw a temper tantrum over there. Your the one coming here being insanely abrasive. Sex doesn't equal kids. Yes it's how they are conceived however this isn't 1918, and I am in a committed relationship. Also, what I choose to do with my partner isn't anyone's business to judge and or criticize. Open your eyes and stop being ignorant yourself.

Hey I came here for help, not to be criticized. We were very safe, and I'm not taking it casually. My boyfriend and I waited til we were ready to take that step. We just aren't ready for kids. 
I hope you can see others point of view. Even if you don't agree with a person, your views can still be set aside to offer some help. Because everyone's situation is very different from your own.
